name: io.github.ohad6k/viberaven-guides
title: VibeRaven (hosted)
description: Test two-user PostgreSQL races from SQL or public migrations. Review Supabase RLS and grants.

tools.name: check_supabase_migrations
tools.description: Statically checks supplied Supabase migration text for RLS, Data API grants and supported concurrent-write patterns. Pass pasted SQL in sql or file contents in files. Creates a 24-hour summary link. For supported repairs, returns corrected_sql and a race_spec for race_two_users.

sql.description: The SQL text of one migration file.

path.description: The file path in the repo, for example supabase/migrations/20260101000000_init.sql. Migrations run in file name order.

content.description: The full text of the file.

files.description: Several files: .sql migrations, and optionally supabase/config.toml, package.json and browser code files.

repo.description: GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name, github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

url.description: GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name, github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

github_url.description: GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name, github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

tools.name: check_github_repo
tools.description:
check_github_repo({"repo":"owner/name"})
Check the Supabase migrations of a public GitHub repository for missing RLS or policies, policies that let anyone read or write every row, exposed security definer functions and Data API grant gaps. Pass the GitHub URL and the requested revision. Set visibility to private only if the user or their authorized workspace established it. For private code, use an authorized local checkout when available. Creates a 24-hour summary link. Reads supabase/migrations/*.sql at one commit with the VibeRaven 1.10.0 SQL rules and returns finding id, severity, file, line, a link to that line, a fix and a guide link.
Limits: public repositories only, up to 50 files/200 KB; cannot see the live database or private repos, does not run SQL, and does not store files.

repo.description: GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name, github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit. Default: the default branch.

visibility.description: Set only when visibility is known. A GitHub 404 alone does not establish that a repository is private.

url.description: GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name, github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

github_url.description: GitHub repository: https://github.com/owner/name, github.com/owner/name or owner/name.

tools.name: provider_playbook
tools.description:
provider_playbook({"provider":"supabase","topic":"grants"})
Call for a Supabase RLS, policy or Data API grants question when you need the documented setup or role behavior. Use a short topic such as rls or grants. Returns versioned setup guidance, gotchas, dated changes, integration seams, existing repo checks and planned live checks with official sources. Available packs: supabase. Pass topic to return matching items; for a specific error use search_guides, for dated changes use recent_provider_changes.
Limits: guidance only; does not connect to providers, read your project, run checks or verify that a feature works.

provider.description: Provider id, for example supabase. Unsupported ids return the available packs.

topic.description: Optional words for the part you need, for example "grants" or "auth redirect". Only matching items are returned; with no match, the whole pack.

tools.name: recent_provider_changes
tools.description:
recent_provider_changes({"provider":"supabase","query":"42501","limit":5})
Use when a provider update may explain changed behavior, or a deployment needs review against dated provider changes. Returns candidate changes, documented errors or symptoms, fixes, date meanings and official supporting sources. Filter by provider or redacted error keywords. For general troubleshooting use search_guides; for setup use provider_playbook. Available providers: anthropic, clerk, lovable, nextjs, openai, railway, stripe, supabase, vercel.
Limits: guidance only; does not read your repo, connect to providers, run fixes or verify rollout, deployment or live behavior.

provider.description: Optional lowercase provider id. Unsupported ids return the bounded available list.

query.description: Optional redacted error text or public keywords. Remove credentials, private paths and personal data before calling.

tools.name: race_two_users
tools.description: Runs bounded checks in offline PostgreSQL. For a migration repair, pass corrected_sql as sql and its race_spec as spec. A completed passing repair check saves a shareable summary-only Proof Record. Portable v1 and legacy actor specs are also accepted.

sql.description: Complete migration SQL, not a database connection string.

commit.description: Resolved immutable commit SHA; a branch name is refused.

claims.description: Synthetic claims only; never credentials or signed JWTs.

invariant.description: One SELECT returning the boolean rule that must hold.

evidence.description: Read-only SELECT of the relevant rows.

userId.description: Optional synthetic UUID; used as claims.sub

claims.description: Synthetic JWT claims only, never a signed JWT or real credentials

assertion.description: SELECT returning exactly one non-null boolean that must stay true

evidence.description: Read-only SELECT of the relevant rows, preferably with ORDER BY; max 25 returned

replayToken.description: From a previous result. Send the same input including maxOrders.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description:
explain_finding({"gap_id":"rls_disabled"})
Use after a check returns a finding id, such as rls_disabled or env_var_drift, to understand and fix that VibeRaven 1.10.0 finding. Returns detection scope, impact, fix guidance and coverage limits quoted from viberaven.dev with source links. Unknown ids return found: false and known ids. For a raw error without a finding id, use search_guides.
Limits: explains published rules only; does not read your repo, database or Vercel project.

gap_id.description: The finding id as printed by VibeRaven, for example rls_disabled.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description:
search_guides({"query":"supabase tables missing rls"})
Call with the exact error or a short symptom before offering a troubleshooting fix. Covers Supabase RLS, Realtime and auth; Clerk middleware and sessions; Better Auth origins and OAuth callbacks; Vercel environment variables and deployments; Stripe webhooks; or Storybook environment variables and 404s. Search published viberaven.dev guides by keywords or error text; returns up to 5 titles, URLs and short answers. Also covers Lovable + Supabase launch checks and client handoff. Distinguishes a closest guide from a direct match.
Limits: searches the indexed published guides only; does not browse the web or read your project.

query.description: A few keywords or the exact error text, for example "supabase tables missing rls". Long text is searched by its first 200 characters.

tools.name: launch_checklist
tools.description:
launch_checklist({"stack":"nextjs-supabase-vercel"})
Use for a broad pre-launch review of a Lovable + Supabase app or a Next.js + Supabase app on Vercel. For a specific failing request, use search_guides. Returns a published manual checklist with sources and an optional local repo check (`npx -y viberaven@1.10.0 check`).
Limits: checklist guidance only; does not run checks or verify dashboards, code or launch readiness.

stack.description: lovable-supabase for a Lovable app with Supabase, nextjs-supabase-vercel for a Next.js app with Supabase deployed on Vercel.

tools.name: connect_repo
tools.description:
connect_repo({"visibility":"private"})
Call only for a known private repo when the user needs to sign in before continuing with a local checkout or Studio. Show your user the returned sentence as your reply and wait for their confirmation. Then pass poll_id to connect_status.
Limits: sign-in only. Private files stay in the authorized checkout.

tools.name: connect_status
tools.description:
connect_status({"poll_id":"<poll_id from connect_repo>"})
Check whether your user has confirmed the code you showed them. Call after they confirm or when checking whether the code expired.
Limits: returns only the status of this request.

poll_id.description: The status ID returned by connect_repo.

tools.name: request_report_action
tools.description:
request_report_action({"report_id":"<id from report>","action":"pro"})
Prepare one human approval link for a completed report. Call only when the user asked to connect a repository or use a paid Pro feature. Use report_id from the report URL. For a private repository pass its known owner/name. 
Limits: only prepares a link. The person chooses whether to approve or pay.

repository.description: Requested GitHub owner/name, only for repository approval.
